name: q.u.q.
source:
This is a story. About a girl. And the Stranger. And... many others. Not may other things, though.

The desert. A girl has been wandering it for days, dragging a giant gun behind her, and now she was completely exhausted and just lay there, acceptant of her fate. Who is that girl? What is her destination and goal?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个故事。关于一个女孩。还有陌生人。还有……许多其他人。不过，其他事情可能不会。

沙漠。一个女孩已经在里面徘徊了好几天，身后拖着一把巨大的枪，现在她已经筋疲力尽了，只是躺在那里，接受了自己的命运。那个女孩是谁？她的目的地和目标是什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302140/]Steam[/url]]
